description: Defines a Repository interface for grocery data operations and an in-memory implementation for demo purposes, including methods for user authentication, product search, cart management, and order processing.

classes.name: InMemoryGroceryRepository
classes.description: A demo implementation of GroceryRepository that manages data in memory, with sample data seeding for products.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, creating a UserProfile if successful.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile, if any.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears the cart.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Searches for products matching the query string.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its unique ID.

methods.name: getCartItems
methods.description: Returns the list of items currently in the cart.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified product and quantity to the cart.

methods.name: updateCart
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item by product ID.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Places an order based on current cart contents, returning order details.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all placed orders.

methods.name: trackOrder
methods.description: Tracks the status of a specific order by ID.
